name: pr-pulse
description: PR Pulse: live status, merge readiness, checks, comments, review queue and change alerts for your GitHub PRs, with a collapsible band

autoFollow.title: Follow the PRs Claude opens
autoFollow.description: After Claude runs gh pr create or git push, watch that pull request (starting as the band if PR Pulse was not open).

ciContext.title: Tell Claude when CI fails
ciContext.description: When a check fails on a PR Claude opened or pushed to, add a short note with the failure log to your next prompt. Nothing is sent on its own.
